card.name: Inside foreign verb stems before infinitive endings
card.fires_on: Partway through a foreign (Latin, Greek, Spanish) verb whose infinitive ending is still to come, e.g. in word-origin notes or Spanish text after 'podría'.

modes.label: Etymology verbs
modes.description: Stem of a Latin or Greek verb quoted in a word-origin note, before its -ere, -are or -ein ending.
modes.example: Latin ichneumōn, weasel, ichneumon fly, from Greek ikhneumōn, from ikhne<<ue>>in, to track, from ikhn

modes.label: Spanish verb after podría
modes.description: Stem of a Spanish infinitive after 'podría', with -ar still to come.
modes.example: El cambio climático global podría<< caus>>ar fenómenos meteorológicos

card.writes: It pushes the model to finish the word with an infinitive ending such as -ать, -ть, -ître or -овать.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a foreign verb, when the ending of the infinitive is the next thing to come.
